segments.en:
I saw Rebbe Yisroel, how he gave everything he had, all the strength and everything he had

To fulfill Rabbainu's words, he rose at midnight and he took, so that the neighbors would not hear

He took the shoes in his hand with, with some, some grasp on some thing

And he went so that no person would hear, he went to speak with Hashem, blessed be He, in a special place

The whole world makes a mockery of this

"What is this? What will I have from this?”

Boruch Hashem, fortunate are we that we merited to be in Rabbainu's portion

For he teaches us how to be a Jew

We need always to rejoice, by day and by night, always to rejoice that we have such a Rebbe

And he teaches us "chatzos,” oh, he says—"Chatzos,” so one needs {…..}

To give everything, "chatzos"

And I saw Rebbe Yisroel, how he was mighty and fought difficult battles over "chatzos,” yo

Our holy Rabbainu says that all our vitality depends on this

We need, as though, as though they want to take all of life

They do everything so that it will not take, th.. th.. th..the soul does not leave, yes

This world and the World to Come are two opposite things, either this or that

Rabbainu, our holy Rabbainu, everything our holy Rabbainu says, in this world and in the World to Come, forever and ever, it is all our vitality, and this.., and we need to sacrifice ourselves for it and not listen to any, any voice in the world

{Su.. suddenly}

The holy Arizal revealed ch.. {...} "Tikkun Chatzos," the holy Arizal, "Shaarei Tzion"

And Rabbainu came and said that we need to fulfill it, to rise, to rise at chatzos

He, {Rabbainu\the Arizal}, the holy one, is the light of all the.. of all Yisroel

Everyone who does not want, he can merit

One does not die if one rises at midnight
